_comment: Comparison corpus ground truth for retrieval-strategy benchmarking.
Each target file uses identifiers that do NOT carry the query vocabulary
so lexical search weights those files low (source-token weight 1) while
semantic search picks up the same intent from dense docstring prose.
'where do we validate user credentials' intentionally trips lexical: the
core/misnamed.py module names functions check_credentials/check_user, so
lexical ranks it first even though it only computes parity bits. Semantic

cases.query: where do we validate user credentials
retry a failed network operation with backoff
scan for source files in the repository
